incident_description:
Impact Summary
Between 05 February 2026 03:44 UTC and 05 February 2026 22:00 UTC, Databricks Apps in AWS us-east-1 may have failed to start or restart.

Symptoms
Databricks Apps may have failed to deploy intermittently.

Current Status
This incident is resolved. Databricks Apps service is functional.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.

Next Update
No further updates are planned unless conditions change.
